name: Topology
description: The study of properties of spaces that are preserved under continuous deformations.

name: Complex Analysis
description: The study of analytic functions of complex variables.

name: Differential Geometry
description: The study of geometry using the techniques of calculus and linear algebra.

name: Algebraic Geometry
description: The branch of mathematics studying zeros of multivariate polynomials.

name: Number Theory
description: The branch of pure mathematics devoted primarily to the study of the integers.

name: Category Theory
description: A general theory of mathematical structures and their relations.

name: Quantum Field Theory
description: The theoretical framework that combines classical field theory, special relativity, and quantum mechanics.

name: Cryptography
description: The practice and study of techniques for secure communication.
